_comment: The four pillars of Sui knowledge, and which skill belongs to each.
A skill with evals but no entry here is reported as unmapped by suievals/list.js rather than
silently dropped, so adding a skill cannot quietly shrink the suite.
ETHEVALS authored 25 evals per pillar, so its cards read x/25 four times. This corpus is the
other way round: the evals were written per skill and the pillars mapped onto them afterwards,
which makes them uneven. Scoring averages the four pillars rather than pooling them, so an
uneven count does not let the largest pillar decide the number.

pillars.name: Objects
pillars.desc: The model everything else rests on. Ownership, abilities, dynamic fields, versioning, and why an account-shaped mental model produces wrong code.

pillars.name: Transactions
pillars.desc: Composing and reading the chain. Programmable transaction blocks, gas and sponsorship, the data-access APIs, and the CLI that drives them.

pillars.name: Building
pillars.desc: Shipping something real. Move packages and their upgrades, the TypeScript SDKs, wallet-connected frontends, and integrating a live protocol.

pillars.name: Security
pillars.desc: What goes wrong. Capability handling and revocation, randomness that survives composition, shared-object authorization, and custody of assets.
